cards.title: Penny Path Compass Shop Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a fictional compass-shop story from draft notes to a final spiral notebook page with a clear opening, useful details, sentence stops, and one quoted line
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for finishing one fictional penny path compass shop story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work offline, place this card beside a spiral notebook, and choose one made-up compass-shop draft note: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, copy the compass-shop story onto one spiral notebook page so it is ready to reread on paper: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy the title and opening sentence so the reader knows the penny path begins in a compass shop: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy slowly on the spiral notebook lines, leaving finger space between words and space for end marks: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Adult asks: Move two draft details into the final copy, such as a penny trail and a small compass shelf: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Adult asks: Touch each sentence stop, then add one end mark where a sentence finishes: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy one made-up quoted line from the shop guide and add who says it: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Reread the final copy on paper and mark one place where the opening, details, and quoted line all belong: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy only the opening sentence and one detail onto the spiral notebook page: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: use the same final-copy steps with another made-up penny path story on paper: ____________________.

cards.title: Pantry Measurement Mystery Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a fictional pantry measurement mystery from planning notes to a final spiral notebook page with clear labels, exact details, sentence stops, and one quoted clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for finishing one fictional pantry measurement mystery story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work offline, set a spiral notebook beside this card, and choose one made-up measurement clue draft: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, copy the pantry mystery into a final spiral notebook version that keeps each clue easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy an opening that names the pantry mystery and the first odd measurement clue: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy each line carefully, keeping numbers, labels, and clue words readable on the spiral notebook page: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Adult asks: Transfer two draft details, such as a mismatched scoop mark and a blank shelf tag, into the final copy: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Adult asks: Draw a tiny dot under each end mark, then fix one sentence that runs into the next: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy one quoted clue from the pretend pantry helper and add a tag that names the helper: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Compare the draft note with the final copy and mark the two clue details that made it onto the page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy only the opening, one clue detail, and one end-marked sentence on paper: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: try the same final-copy pass with another made-up measurement mystery: ____________________.

cards.title: Compost Clock Workshop Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a fictional compost clock workshop story into a final spiral notebook page with clear order, workshop details, sentence stops, and one quoted instruction
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for finishing one fictional compost clock workshop story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work offline, place this card beside a spiral notebook, and choose one made-up workshop draft with a clock dial clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, copy the workshop story in order so the final spiral notebook page can be reread on paper: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy an opening that places the character inside the compost clock workshop before the dial clue changes: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy the final version with steady line spacing and clear end marks on the spiral notebook page: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Adult asks: Transfer two useful workshop details, such as a leaf gear and a turning paper dial, from draft to final copy: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Adult asks: Check where each workshop action ends, then add an end mark before the next action begins: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy one quoted instruction from the workshop helper and add who gives it: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Reread the final copy and mark where the opening, two details, and quoted instruction are easy to find: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy only the opening and one workshop detail before stopping the paper pass: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: repeat the final-copy steps with another made-up workshop clue story: ____________________.

cards.title: Almost Invention Workshop Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a fictional almost-invention workshop story into a polished spiral notebook page with a purposeful opening, transferred evidence, sentence control, and precise dialogue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for finishing one fictional almost-invention workshop story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work offline, set the spiral notebook beside this card, and choose one made-up invention draft with rough test notes: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, copy the invention story into final form while preserving the best draft details on paper: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy an opening that names the almost-invention and hints at what still needs fixing: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy in a steady final-copy pass, keeping paragraph breaks, margins, and end marks clear: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Adult asks: Transfer three exact draft details, such as a cardboard gear, a bent lever, and a repair note, into the final copy: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Adult asks: Find one long sentence, divide it into two clear sentences, and copy both into the final version: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy one quoted workshop exchange and keep each speaker tag clear on the notebook page: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Reread the final copy against the draft and mark one line where the invention problem reads clearly: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy one paragraph only, including one transferred detail and one clear end mark: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: use the same final-copy pass with another made-up almost-invention draft: ____________________.

cards.title: Blue Pencil Observatory Final Copy Card

cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, copy the observatory story into a final paper version that keeps the clues in a clear order: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy an opening that introduces the blue pencil observatory and the first sky-chart clue: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy with even margins, clear paragraph breaks, and readable pencil marks on the spiral notebook page: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Adult asks: Transfer three draft details, such as a dome window, a blue pencil mark, and a quiet chart table, into final copy: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Adult asks: Underline one place where a sentence should end, then copy the corrected sentence with an end mark: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Adult asks: Copy one quoted line between two observatory helpers and keep each tag clear: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Reread the final copy and mark where the opening, clue details, sentence stops, and quoted line are all present: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy only the opening and one clue sentence onto the spiral notebook page: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: repeat the paper-only final-copy steps with another made-up observatory clue: ____________________.
